data.name: Ashok
data.gender_notes: Ashok is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + śoka, 'sorrow' — 'without sorrow'. Its root is Sanskrit a + śoka. Emperor Ashoka the Great; also a tree. Ashok is a Sanskrit name meaning “Without sorrow; free from grief”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashok expresses “Without sorrow; free from grief”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + śoka, 'sorrow' — 'without sorrow'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashok total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
